verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since embedding components into an existing server-rendered page is a fair question for a UI framework. However, nothing in the pack covers mounting components into existing HTML or incremental/island-style adoption. The evidence only covers the compiler model, runes, scaffolding new projects (sv create, and sv add for existing Svelte projects), and SvelteKit SSG/SPA modes, none of which show drop-in use on an existing page.
